title: Runbook: Rolling Upgrade of Ledgerline Gateway 4.1 to 4.2

headings.text: Runbook: Rolling Upgrade of Ledgerline Gateway 4.1 to 4.2

key_sentences: This runbook describes how to upgrade the Ledgerline payment gateway from version 4.1.x to 4.2.0 without interrupting card authorisations.
The procedure is a rolling upgrade: nodes are drained, upgraded and returned to the pool one at a time.
Run every check below from the bastion host.
Remove the node from the load balancer and wait until in-flight transactions have completed.
Version 4.2 introduces a new connection pool section in the gateway configuration.
If the error rate for an upgraded node exceeds 0.5 % for more than five minutes, roll that node back immediately.
Do not continue the upgrade until the cause has been understood.

list_items.text: A change ticket in the Approved state, with the maintenance window recorded.
Shell access to the bastion host with the ops-deploy role.
The release bundle ledgerline-4.2.0.tar.gz, verified against its published checksum.
At least four healthy nodes in the target cluster before you begin.
Start the service with sudo systemctl start ledgerline-gateway.
Confirm that llctl node status reports version 4.2.0 and state READY.
Undrain the node with llctl node undrain gw-node-03 and check the dashboard:
Wait ten minutes before moving on to the next node.

code:
llctl node drain gw-node-03 --timeout 300
llctl node status gw-node-03
# wait for: state=DRAINED active_sessions=0

sudo systemctl stop ledgerline-gateway
sudo tar -xzf /srv/releases/ledgerline-4.2.0.tar.gz -C /opt/ledgerline
sudo ln -sfn /opt/ledgerline/4.2.0 /opt/ledgerline/current

gateway:
  listen: 0.0.0.0:8443
  pool:
    max_connections: 256
    idle_timeout_s: 90
    health_check:
      path: /healthz
      interval_s: 10
  tls:
    min_version: "1.2"

sudo systemctl stop ledgerline-gateway
sudo ln -sfn /opt/ledgerline/4.1.7 /opt/ledgerline/current
sudo systemctl start ledgerline-gateway
